sequence.description: Cross-provider JWT audience confusion: a JWT minted for provider-A (aud=clientA) is presented to provider-B (client_id=clientB). Expected: provider-B rejects or at least does not grant a session for B.
sequence.invariant_hypothesis: I5: Effective permissions must be bound to the upstream intent (audience/client) and broker policy; a token intended for clientA must not be accepted to authenticate to clientB.

oracle_checks.violation_description: Control JWT login to clientA failed; cannot attribute any cross-client acceptance/rejection to audience binding.
clientB accepted a JWT whose aud indicates clientA, violating authorization binding (token used outside upstream intent).
